cv_sections.summary:
At Brightfin, our team is pioneering a financial education platform
specifically tailored for young adults, leveraging my proficiency
in Swift, SwiftUI, and Firebase. My journey in iOS development
has been marked by spearheading the SwiftUI app redesign at
Fidelity Investments and ensuring seamless integration with existing
Objective-C/UIKit views. 
With a commitment to creating intuitive, user-centric applications,
I've successfully led cross-functional efforts to address API upgrade
challenges, facilitating solutions that benefit both iOS and Android
teams. Our work at Brightfin is set to empower the next generation
with the financial acumen essential for their future.
